systems.system: data sharing agreements between UBOS and CRVS data-generating institutions

note: Reports that the NIRA-led CRVS Technical Working Group met on 30 April 2026, with a business process map for health facility deaths, a presentation of NIRA's new NSIS, the 2025 Vital Statistics Report and UBOS data sharing agreements on its agenda; the NSIS is named without a description of what it does, and nothing is said of how or where events are recorded.
